text: Applicants for foundation program should hold a high school diploma and be under the age of 24. Applicants who are still under the age of 18 as of September 1st, 2025 must submit the original guardian certificate issued by the Tianjin District Notary Office, and the Guardian must be a permanent resident of Tianjin. For Chinese-instructed program applicants: Students are required to submit HSK-5 certificates with the minimum score of 180. HSK 4 (180 or above) for programs in school of international education. Native Chinese speakers and applicants who complete the lastest study in Chinese are allowed to be exempted from providing HSK Certificates. Applicants for Foundation Program (March 2025) need to submit HSK-4 or above, or certificate of Chinese learning for more than one year.
